punchline: Mark Manson spent years dreaming of being a rock star and never became one, because he wanted the stage and not the work.
thirty_sec: Mark Manson fantasized for years about being a rock star. It never happened, and later he understood why: he wanted the result, not the process. That's behind the question in his book: what pain do you want in your life? Everyone wants a great job or a fit body, so wanting them tells you nothing. The people who enjoy the uncertainty of the starving artist's life are the ones who end up making it.
key_contrast: Loving the work, not the prize
